text:
Amber: Quick sync — we need to lock launch thresholds for the multi-model routing initiative. Who owns final latency SLO + degraded fallback?
Liam: Runtime owns latency SLO definitions/monitoring, product sets targets. I can draft the SLO doc.
Amber: @Liam can you commit to p95 targets? product suggested p95=120ms for standard.
Liam: p95=120ms is optimistic on current infra for generative requests. Suggest p95=200ms GA, 120ms for premium customers.
Sara: Infra note: if GA needs dedicated pools we need commit numbers (GPU-hours) by EOD Tue to lock procurement and cost.
Devon: From product: if we accept p95=200ms for GA we should tighten rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to smaller model on error >=3%.
Maya: Security: we require a short audit for new model routing patterns + KMS key provisioning before any canary. That audit adds ~3 business days.
Amber: Timeline question — does +3 days break planned launch week?
Liam: We can absorb +3 days if infra confirms capacity Tues and API v2 merge joins by Fri. We'll re-prioritize a couple infra tasks.
Sara: OpsBot: reserve request for dedicated pool submitted. Waiting for finance approval — ref #cap-reserve-502.
OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Reserve queued — estimated approval 48h.
Devon: Action items: @Liam write SLO doc with fallback thresholds, @Sara confirm GPU-hour numbers & cost by Tue, @Maya start the security audit ticket, @Amber finalize customer acceptance test checklist.
Amber: Added to tomorrow 9am sync agenda. Also let's keep the launch criteria explicit: (1) SLO doc approved, (2) capacity reserved, (3) security audit cleared, (4) canary rollback policy in infra, (5) customer acceptance tests passing.
Liam: I'll post an initial SLO PR by EOD today.
Maya: Security ticket created: #sec-1189. ETA initial review in 48h.
Sara: I'll chase finance and post numbers in the channel once confirmed.
Amber: Thanks — short thread but actionable. See you at 9am. :rocket:
